meta.title: Sample specialist directory for referable diabetic retinopathy
meta.note: Every hospital, doctor and phone number in this file is invented for demonstration. Phone numbers use the +91 80 0XXX XXXX pattern: Indian subscriber numbers do not begin with 0, which is the trunk prefix, so these should not reach a real line. Localities are real Bengaluru neighbourhoods, used only to make the sample read naturally.
